title: Dynamic Coupon Targeting Using Batch Deep Reinforcement Learning: An Application to Livestream Shopping
eligible_reason: Batch deep reinforcement learning for dynamic coupon targeting on Alibaba livestream shopping: ML demand models (OLS, GBDT, DNN, ORF, structural), doubly robust off-policy evaluation and a randomized field experiment. No DiD.
